01_intro
This is moduwallet: a simple, clean wallet for U.S. stocks, built on the True Markets Gateway API.
02_home
Your balance, today's change, and everything you own, on one calm screen.
03_search
Search more than ninety tokenized stocks and ETFs, like Nvidia, Tesla, or the S and P five hundred, plus Bitcoin and Ethereum.
04_detail
Prices and charts come live from True Markets market data.
05_buy
Buying is a single sheet. Type a dollar amount, or switch to shares.
06_quote
You get a real-time True Markets quote, with the fee and the price spread explained in plain words.
07_done
Confirm, and it is in your wallet.
08_lev
Leverage is usually confusing. We turned it into a few simple questions.
09_dir
First: do you think it will go up, or down?
10_mult
Then pick a multiplier, and see exactly what it means. One percent up is five percent for you, and you see how far a drop would wipe out your money.
11_open
A short scenario table and a one time risk check, and your position is open.
12_pos
Track your profit, and how close you are to liquidation, at a glance. Close it with one tap.
13_hist
History shows realized profit, loss, and fees.
14_lang
And moduwallet speaks your language: English, Korean, Chinese, Thai, Vietnamese, and Russian.
15_outro
This demo uses real True Markets quotes with simulated fills. moduwallet. Easy stocks, for everyone.
